note: Adapted from the English redescription of Scheffrahn & Křeček 1999; the original description is Scheffrahn 1993 (Juanillo, Dominican Republic), which was not obtained for this batch. The morphology and measurements given here are all from Scheffrahn & Křeček 1999 (alates: 2 females and 3 males from 1 single colony; soldiers: 16 individuals from 6 colonies). The most conspicuous diagnostic character of the soldier is the dark chestnut brown trident-shaped patch across the frontal face on the rusty background of the anterior part of the head, concolorous with the two pairs of horns and the postclypeus.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Body pale yellow, the abdominal tergites yellow. Head pale yellow, with a slightly darker transverse band between the compound eyes. Chevron on the forewing scale faint, concolorous with the posterior corners of the pale yellow pronotum; rest of the pronotum pale yellow, with a distinct white median line intersecting the white transverse band to form a cross. Labrum, antennae and legs yellow, the femora pale yellow. Wing membrane almost transparent, with a pale golden iridescence; anterior sclerotized veins pale orange, fading towards the apex. Cranial sutures indistinct. Compound eyes medium-sized, oval. Ocelli oval, touching the compound eyes. Antennae 13—16-segmented, usually 14 or 15, the segment formula variable. Pronotum distinctly narrower than the head across the compound eyes; nearly square, the sides nearly straight and slightly divergent posteriorly, or slightly convex; anterior margin moderately concave, the posterior margin shallowly concave in the middle. Radius of the forewing meeting the wing margin at one third to one half of the wing length from the suture; radial sector with 4 branches. Arolium present.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Measurements (2 females and 3 males, 1 colony, in mm): head length including the labrum 1.26—1.36 (1.30±0.053); head length to the postclypeus 1.05—1.11 (1.08±0.033); maximum head width across the compound eyes 1.16—1.19 (1.18±0.013); compound eye diameter 0.37—0.38 (0.37±0.0045); shortest distance from the compound eye to the posterior margin of the head 0.15—0.17 (0.17±0.011); ocellus diameter 0.14—0.16 (0.15±0.0068); maximum pronotal length 0.78—0.82 (0.80±0.015); maximum pronotal width 1.01—1.10 (1.05±0.031); total body length with wings 11.50—12.50 (12.18±0.45); total body length without wings 5.68—6.53 (6.25±0.33); forewing length (from the suture) 9.09—9.73 (9.39±0.25); maximum forewing width 2.44—2.54 (2.51±0.040).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head, in dorsal view, rusty over the anterior half (including the frontal margin), with a dark chestnut brown trident-shaped patch across the frontal face, concolorous with the two pairs of frontal and genal horns and the postclypeus; the posterior half of the head rusty or rusty orange. In lateral view the anterior part of the head rusty, the two pairs of frontal and genal horns dark chestnut brown, grading posteriorly to rusty orange. Mandibles nearly black at the apex, usually paler at the base, chestnut brown or dark chestnut brown. Anterior margin of the pronotum orange-yellow, the remainder pale yellow. Head capsule long, about 1.25 times as long as wide; the sides and posterior margin slightly convex, the posterior corners rounded. In some specimens the sides of the head nearly parallel and slightly divergent posteriorly, the posterior margin nearly straight. Frontal face with shallow depressions corresponding to the dark patches, and with a slightly raised transverse band formed by the postclypeus and the frontal horns. Frontal face meeting the vertex face at 40°. Labrum with short, convergent sides, the apex triangular and swollen; anterolateral margins concave. Frontal horns small, rounded at the tip, continuous with the postclypeus and the frontal face; the surface of the horns granular. Genal horns small.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Measurements (16 individuals, 6 colonies, in mm): head length to the tip of the mandibles 2.26—2.51 (2.40±0.083); head length to the frontal horns 1.62—1.78 (1.68±0.054); frontal margin width 1.08—1.19 (1.14±0.034); outer span of the frontal horns 0.96—1.05 (0.99±0.026); maximum head width 1.34—1.42 (1.37±0.024); head height without the postmentum 1.00—1.06 (1.02±0.021); maximum pronotal width 1.18—1.37 (1.25±0.050); maximum pronotal length 0.69—0.88 (0.77±0.048); left mandible length (apex to ventral articulation) 1.06—1.21 (1.11±0.039); total body length 4.77—6.09 (5.44±0.36).
